title: Execution of the halving program
statement: Let a program $P$ contain the halving program at position $p$, let $h$ be a natural number, and let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ be a memory state. Suppose $h+1\leq\mathrm{word}(\mathrm{lim})$. Starting at depth $d$ with input frame $[h]$ and memory $\mu$, the program meets the time bound $10\lfloor(h+1)/2\rfloor+10$ at position $p$: it has an execution whose output at location $0$ is the integer $\lfloor(h+1)/2\rfloor$ and whose memory remains $\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: A position $p$ containing the halving program
